name: MoodBored
description: Collaborative mood-board workspace — visual brainstorming canvas that any LLM can drive via MCP tools

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read the full board state — items, palette, typography, spatial layout, relationships

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Add one or more items to the board (notes, images, palettes, gradients, fonts, links, videos, containers, etc.)

tools.name: remove_items
tools.description: Remove items from the board by their IDs

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update properties of an existing item (text, colors, tags, position, etc.)

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search items by text query and/or tag filter

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Search items by meaning — finds related concepts even with different wording

tools.name: related_items
tools.description: Find items semantically related to a given item

tools.name: arrange_items
tools.description: Organize items into a layout (grid, horizontal stack, vertical stack, spiral)

tools.name: clear_board
tools.description: Remove all items from the board

resources.name: summary
resources.description: Text summary of the board (item counts by type)
